Class User

java.lang.Object
com.flipfit.bean.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, GymCustomer, GymOwner
public class User extends Object
The Class User. This class represents a generic user in the FlipFit system. It acts as a base class for specific user roles such as Admin, GymOwner, and GymCustomer. It contains common user attributes like name, email, password, role ID, and active status.
